issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) requires the Lecture constructor to initialize attributes in the order: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. The solution's constructor signature uses a different parameter order (lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution will confuse students about the expected constructor signature and may cause tests that check constructor parameters or student implementations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the constructor parameter order across artifacts. Either update the solution constructor to match the UML/specification: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } or update the problem statement/UML to reflect the constructor parameter order used in the solution. Ensure template, tests, and solution are consistent.
